body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy or its visible ordinary magical effect within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Arcane Damage to the enemy and suppress one ordinary magical numerical bonus worth 1 until the start of your next turn. An unattended ordinary effect may be targeted against Difficulty 6 instead.

surges.html: Also suppress 1 point of magical Movement bonus on a hit.
End the chosen ordinary bonus rather than suppressing it. Specialty Conditions are unaffected.

rider.title: Aether Thread
rider.html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.
